snippet.title: UFO Mayhem Release Trailer
snippet.description:
UFO Mayhem is an action arcade game for the Playdate! Play as a devious UFO and destroy buildings, abduct humans, and defend yourself from the human resistance.
Get it now on itch.io! https://mirrordoor.itch.io/ufo-mayhem

Please consider leaving a comment or a review!  I would really appreciate your feedback!
